note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 6 May 1936. Thirteen divisions were filled unopposed and no nomination was received for Glenmakeeran, where the retiring member, Mr. H. H. Osborne, was re-elected. Polling in County Antrim was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
